rationale: The core entry premise — sellers in control with price accepting below VWAP — is now falsified: price has reclaimed VWAP (8.33 vs 8.32) and the last 1-minute candle closed near its high after tagging the 8.37 lower-high, while the tape is marginally less hostile (SPY -0.44%, VIXY fading) and the trade never showed a single tick of profit. Holding leaves a thesis-less short roughly 1% from the 8.41 stop in a name with ~2% 5-minute ATR, risking an extra ~$80-150 for little informational edge. A flip long is not warranted since price is running directly into 8.37-8.41 supply after a 9.6% bounce off the lows with a 36bp spread, so the correct move is simply to exit flat at a modest loss.
